name: Pepicons Pencil
about: Pepicons Pencil is a free, open-source icon set with 1,275 icons designed by CyCraft. From navigation and actions to files, media and communication, it covers everyday UI needs. Every icon is available as SVG, PNG and WebP, or as a copy-paste React / TypeScript component or CDN link. Recolor and resize each one in the browser before you export – free, no account needed. Licensed under CC BY 4.0.

faqs.q: Are Pepicons Pencil free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All 1,275 Pepicons Pencil are open source under the CC BY 4.0 license – free to download, customize and use. Always check the CC BY 4.0 terms for attribution or commercial-use requirements.

faqs.q: How do I use Pepicons Pencil in React or my website?
faqs.a: Copy any icon as a React / TypeScript component straight into your project, or paste the CDN link into your HTML. Every icon also downloads as SVG, PNG or WebP, and you can recolor and resize it in the browser before you export.

faqs.q: How many Pepicons Pencil are there?
faqs.a: There are 1,275 icons in the Pepicons Pencil set, designed by CyCraft. Use the search above to find any icon by name.

faqs.q: Can I change the color and size of Pepicons Pencil?
faqs.a: Yes. Open any icon, pick a size and color, and the preview updates instantly. SVG, PNG and WebP exports follow your choices, and React snippets recolor through props.

faqs.q: What formats are Pepicons Pencil available in?
faqs.a: SVG, PNG and WebP downloads, copy-paste React / TypeScript components, plus a CDN link for every single icon – free, no account needed.
